items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: No, I didn't know him. I knew of him.

ctx.x: No, I didn't know him. I knew of him. He was a piano player here. I just thought you'd know him because of the names or something, you know. I imagine you've heard of him. No, I didn't know him.
Alfred Carroll? No, I know Alibrad Alexander.
